description: Horizontal strip of a top-down pixel art fantasy world map: sunlit southern grassland plains with a few scattered single trees, opening southward to a low coastline with a thin golden beach along the bottom edge and the first turquoise water in the bottom corners. Broad, open, calm. No buildings, no text, no borders.

reference_images.usage: above: the meadow, forest edge and coast beginning immediately north of this strip; continue it southward
